# Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(ggrepel)
library(performance)
```

# Load Data

```{r load-data}
gratsfeb <- read.csv("globalrats_feb_grades.csv")
bioclim  <- read.csv("bioclimdata_sep25.csv")
source("calculate_smi.R")
```

# Finalized Raw Data

```{r finalized-raw}
# Remove excluded cities/individuals; standardize age classes and city names
gratsfebfin <- gratsfeb |>
  filter(
    !(city %in% c("Tarlac", "Sihanouk", "Mondolkiri", "Ratchaburi")),
    Rat_ID != "24R-116",
    !Rat_ID %in% c("153", "557", "ED02", "ND1287"),
    !UR.ID %in% c("Rat8546", "Rat8545"),
    city != "Helsinki" | condition %in% c("live", "kill")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    grams = as.numeric(grams),
    # Collapse age classes into Adult / Non-Adult / Unknown
    second_age = case_when(
      age %in% c("Juvenile", "Subadult", "Nonadult", "Non-Adult") ~ "Non-Adult",
      age %in% c("Adult", "gravid", "lact", "lactating", "mat",
                 "scars", "7 fetuses")                            ~ "Adult",
      TRUE                                                        ~ "Unknown"),
    # Rename NYC sub-sites
    city = case_when(
      city == "NYC1" ~ "NYC_Firth",
      city == "NYC2" ~ "NYC_Combs",
      TRUE           ~ city),
    # Correct three Boston individuals miscategorised as Non-Adult
    across(c(age, second_age),
      ~if_else(city == "Boston" & second_age == "Non-Adult" &
               Rat_ID %in% c("2021-25", "2022-91", "2021-52"), "Adult", .x))
  )
```

# Grade City Lists

```{r grade-lists}
# Gold cities: highest data-quality tier
gold_cities <- c("Vancouver_CH", "Boston", "Helsinki", "Salvador", "Chicago",
                 "Vienna", "Richmond", "Oakland", "Sacramento", "DC",
                 "San Diego", "LA")

# Silver cities: second-tier data quality
silver_cities <- c("Kuching", "NYC_Firth", "Vancouver_KB",
                   "Buenos Aires", "Singapore")

# Bronze cities: third-tier; require interpolated adult cutoffs
bronze_cities <- c("Auckland", "NYC_Combs", "Amsterdam", "Rotterdam",
                   "New Orleans", "Paris", "Barcelona", "Valencia",
                   "Tokyo", "Wellington")
```

# DELIVERABLE 1 — Sex Ratio for Gold & Silver *Rattus rattus* Adults

```{r sex-ratio}
# ── Filter to Rr adults from Gold and Silver cities ──────────────────────────
sex_ratio_rr <- gratsfebfin |>
  filter(
    species    == "Rr",
    second_age == "Adult",
    city %in% c(gold_cities, silver_cities),
    sex %in% c("M", "F")
  ) |>
  # Count M/F per city, carrying grade along
  group_by(city, grade, sex) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  # Compute percent within each city
  group_by(city) |>
  mutate(
    total   = sum(n),
    percent = round(n / total * 100, 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Flag the dominant sex in each city
sex_ratio_rr <- sex_ratio_rr |>
  group_by(city) |>
  mutate(dominant = sex[which.max(percent)]) |>
  ungroup()

sex_ratio_rr
```

```{r sex-ratio-plot}
# Stacked bar: % male vs female, faceted by grade
ggplot(sex_ratio_rr, aes(x = reorder(city, percent), y = percent, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~grade, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "#4E79A7", "F" = "#F28E2B"),
                    labels = c("M" = "Male", "F" = "Female")) +
  labs(title    = "Sex Ratio of Adult Rr — Gold & Silver Cities",
       x        = NULL,
       y        = "Percent (%)",
       fill     = "Sex") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw()
```

# DELIVERABLE 2 — Sex-Specific Analysis Setup

All subsequent analyses are run **separately for Males and Females**.

```{r sex-split}
# Convenience filtered subsets reused in later deliverables
# Gold + Silver Rr adults — male
gs_rr_adult_male <- gratsfebfin |>
  filter(
    species    == "Rr",
    second_age == "Adult",
    city %in% c(gold_cities, silver_cities),
    sex == "M",
    !is.na(grams),
    !is.na(bio1)
  )

# Gold + Silver Rr adults — female
gs_rr_adult_female <- gratsfebfin |>
  filter(
    species    == "Rr",
    second_age == "Adult",
    city %in% c(gold_cities, silver_cities),
    sex == "F",
    !is.na(grams),
    !is.na(bio1)
  )
```

# DELIVERABLE 3 — Rr Line of Best Fit (Gold + Silver), Bronze Classification

## 3a. Rn Reference (existing approach — preserved exactly)

```{r rn-lobf-reference, eval=FALSE}
# Existing Rn pipeline (shown for reference; sg_rnadult_hsum_feb already built)
# sg_rnadult_hsum_feb: city-level summary with min_weight ~ bio1
# lm_rn  <- lm(min_weight ~ bio1, data = sg_rnadult_hsum_feb)
# pred_rn <- predict(lm_rn, newdata = sg_rnadult_hsum_feb)
# (plot with geom_text_repel; equation extracted from coef(lm_rn))
```

## 3b. Rr LOBF — city-level min weight summary

```{r rr-lobf-summary}
# Summarise minimum adult weight per city (bio1 fixed within city)
sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male <- gs_rr_adult_male |>
  group_by(city, bio1) |>
  summarise(
    min_weight = min(grams, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female <- gs_rr_adult_female |>
  group_by(city, bio1) |>
  summarise(
    min_weight = min(grams, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )
```

## 3c. Rr LM — min weight ~ bio1

```{r rr-lobf-lm}
# Male LOBF
lm_rr_male   <- lm(min_weight ~ bio1, data = sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male)
lm_rr_male_coef <- coef(lm_rr_male)

# Female LOBF
lm_rr_female <- lm(min_weight ~ bio1, data = sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female)
lm_rr_female_coef <- coef(lm_rr_female)

# Print equations
cat("Male   Rr LOBF: min_weight =",
    round(lm_rr_male_coef["(Intercept)"], 3), "+",
    round(lm_rr_male_coef["bio1"], 3), "* bio1\n")

cat("Female Rr LOBF: min_weight =",
    round(lm_rr_female_coef["(Intercept)"], 3), "+",
    round(lm_rr_female_coef["bio1"], 3), "* bio1\n")

summary(lm_rr_male)
summary(lm_rr_female)
```

## 3d. LOBF Plots

```{r rr-lobf-plot-male}
# Predict fitted line for males
sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male <- sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male |>
  mutate(pred_min_weight = predict(lm_rr_male, newdata = sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male))

ggplot(sg_rradult_hsum_feb_male, aes(x = bio1, y = min_weight)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "#4E79A7") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_min_weight), colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = city), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Rr Male — Min Adult Weight vs Mean Annual Temperature\n(Gold + Silver Cities)",
    x     = "Bio1 (Mean Annual Temp × 10, °C)",
    y     = "Minimum Adult Weight (g)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r rr-lobf-plot-female}
# Predict fitted line for females
sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female <- sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female |>
  mutate(pred_min_weight = predict(lm_rr_female, newdata = sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female))

ggplot(sg_rradult_hsum_feb_female, aes(x = bio1, y = min_weight)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "#F28E2B") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_min_weight), colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = city), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Rr Female — Min Adult Weight vs Mean Annual Temperature\n(Gold + Silver Cities)",
    x     = "Bio1 (Mean Annual Temp × 10, °C)",
    y     = "Minimum Adult Weight (g)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 3e. Apply Rr LOBF to Bronze — Interpolated Adult Cutoff

```{r bronze-rr-cutoff}
# Apply male and female LOBF equations to bronze Rr individuals
# to derive a city-specific predicted minimum adult weight, then
# classify each individual as Adult or Non-Adult against that threshold.

bronze_rr_raw <- gratsfebfin |>
  filter(
    species == "Rr",
    city %in% bronze_cities,
    !is.na(grams),
    !is.na(bio1),
    sex %in% c("M", "F")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Predicted min weight uses sex-specific equation
    predminweight_rr = case_when(
      sex == "M" ~ lm_rr_male_coef["(Intercept)"]   + lm_rr_male_coef["bio1"]   * bio1,
      sex == "F" ~ lm_rr_female_coef["(Intercept)"] + lm_rr_female_coef["bio1"] * bio1
    ),
    # Classify: Adult if weight >= predicted cutoff
    gsbr_ageclass_rr = if_else(grams >= predminweight_rr, "Adult", "Non-Adult")
  )

# Final bronze Rr dataframe — adults only, mirroring br_feb_final structure
br_rr_feb_final <- bronze_rr_raw |>
  filter(gsbr_ageclass_rr == "Adult")

cat("Bronze Rr adults (male)  :", sum(br_rr_feb_final$sex == "M"), "\n")
cat("Bronze Rr adults (female):", sum(br_rr_feb_final$sex == "F"), "\n")
```

# DELIVERABLE 4 — LMEM: Rr Body Mass ~ Bio1 + (1 | city)

## 4a. Model A — Gold + Silver Only

```{r lmem-model-a}
# ── Male ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lmer_rr_gs_male <- lmer(grams ~ bio1 + (1 | city), data = gs_rr_adult_male,
                        REML = FALSE)
summary(lmer_rr_gs_male)
r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_male)

# ── Female ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lmer_rr_gs_female <- lmer(grams ~ bio1 + (1 | city), data = gs_rr_adult_female,
                          REML = FALSE)
summary(lmer_rr_gs_female)
r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_female)
```

### Model A Prediction Plots

```{r lmem-a-plot-male}
# City-level label positions: mean bio1 & mean grams per city
city_labels_gs_male <- gs_rr_adult_male |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarise(bio1  = mean(bio1,  na.rm = TRUE),
            grams = mean(grams, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Population-level prediction (re.form = NA)
pred_gs_male <- gs_rr_adult_male |>
  mutate(fit = predict(lmer_rr_gs_male, newdata = gs_rr_adult_male,
                       re.form = NA))

ggplot(pred_gs_male, aes(x = bio1, y = grams)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.35, colour = "#4E79A7", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fit), colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = city_labels_gs_male,
                  aes(label = city), size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title = "Model A — Rr Male: Grams ~ Bio1 (Gold + Silver Cities)",
    x     = "Bio1 (Mean Annual Temp × 10, °C)",
    y     = "Body Mass (g)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r lmem-a-plot-female}
city_labels_gs_female <- gs_rr_adult_female |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarise(bio1  = mean(bio1,  na.rm = TRUE),
            grams = mean(grams, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

pred_gs_female <- gs_rr_adult_female |>
  mutate(fit = predict(lmer_rr_gs_female, newdata = gs_rr_adult_female,
                       re.form = NA))

ggplot(pred_gs_female, aes(x = bio1, y = grams)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.35, colour = "#F28E2B", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fit), colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = city_labels_gs_female,
                  aes(label = city), size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title = "Model A — Rr Female: Grams ~ Bio1 (Gold + Silver Cities)",
    x     = "Bio1 (Mean Annual Temp × 10, °C)",
```

## 4b. Model B — Gold + Silver + Bronze (Interpolated)

```{r lmem-model-b-data}
# Combine Gold/Silver adults with interpolated Bronze Rr adults
gs_rr_adult_male_full <- gs_rr_adult_male |>
  mutate(source = "gold_silver")

br_rr_male <- br_rr_feb_final |>
  filter(sex == "M") |>
  mutate(source = "bronze")

br_rr_female <- br_rr_feb_final |>
  filter(sex == "F") |>
  mutate(source = "bronze")

gs_rr_adult_female_full <- gs_rr_adult_female |>
  mutate(source = "gold_silver")

# Full male dataset
rr_adult_male_full <- bind_rows(gs_rr_adult_male_full, br_rr_male)

# Full female dataset
rr_adult_female_full <- bind_rows(gs_rr_adult_female_full, br_rr_female)
```

```{r lmem-model-b}
# ── Male ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lmer_rr_gsb_male <- lmer(grams ~ bio1 + (1 | city), data = rr_adult_male_full,
                         REML = FALSE)
summary(lmer_rr_gsb_male)
r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_male)

# ── Female ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lmer_rr_gsb_female <- lmer(grams ~ bio1 + (1 | city), data = rr_adult_female_full,
                           REML = FALSE)
summary(lmer_rr_gsb_female)
r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_female)
```


## 4c. Model Comparison Summary

```{r model-comparison}
# Compare marginal and conditional R² across models
tibble(
  Model   = c("A Male", "A Female", "B Male", "B Female"),
  Dataset = c("Gold+Silver", "Gold+Silver", "Gold+Silver+Bronze", "Gold+Silver+Bronze"),
  Sex     = c("M", "F", "M", "F"),
  R2m     = c(r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_male)[1,   "R2m"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_female)[1,  "R2m"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_male)[1,   "R2m"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_female)[1, "R2m"]),
  R2c     = c(r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_male)[1,   "R2c"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gs_female)[1,  "R2c"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_male)[1,   "R2c"],
              r.squaredGLMM(lmer_rr_gsb_female)[1, "R2c"])
) |>
  mutate(across(c(R2m, R2c), ~round(.x, 3)))
```
